caption_used: Coverage as a function of the number of completions (k) for Llama-3B, Llama-3B + FT, Llama-1B, and Llama-1B + FT. All four models exhibit monotonically increasing coverage with additional completions on a logarithmic x-axis from 2^0 to 2^8. The 3B models begin at approximately 0.42 coverage and reach roughly 0.92 at k=256, while the 1B variants start near 0.22 and plateau at approximately 0.72 by k=128 with minimal further gains. Notably, fine-tuning provides a consistent advantage of approximately 5 percentage points for the 1B model throughout the scaling curve, whereas the 3B base and fine-tuned variants remain largely indistinguishable.
raw_response: DESCRIPTION: The plot displays the coverage of four models—Llama-3B, Llama-3B + FT, Llama-1B, and Llama-1B + FT—as a function of the number of completions (k), with the x-axis representing the number of completions on a logarithmic scale ranging from 2⁰ to 2⁸, and the y-axis showing coverage values from 0.2 to 0.9. Each model is represented by a distinct line: Llama-3B is shown with blue circles connected by a solid line, Llama-3B + FT with green triangles connected by a solid line, Llama-1B with light blue inverted triangles connected by a dashed line, and Llama-1B + FT with light blue circles connected by a dashed line. All four lines exhibit a monotonically increasing trend, with coverage rising as the number of completions increases. At k=2⁰, Llama-3B starts at approximately 0.42 and increases to about 0.92 at k=2⁵ (32), while Llama-3B + FT begins slightly higher at around 0.44 and reaches approximately 0.93 at k=2⁸ (256). Llama-1B begins at roughly 0.22 and increases to about 0.72 at k=2⁷ (128), after which it plateaus with minimal further increase. Llama-1B + FT starts at approximately 0.27 and reaches about 0.77 at k=2⁷, also plateauing thereafter. The fine-tuned 1B model consistently shows a coverage advantage of approximately 0.05 over the base 1B model across all values of k, while the fine-tuned and base 3B models remain nearly indistinguishable throughout the range.
